name: Hide2Less
tagline: 在手机上将受支持的 RootHide 插件包转换为 Rootless 安装包。
notice: 当前为测试版。部分 iOS 16 Rootless 设备仍可能转换失败，问题正在排查。并非所有插件都能转换，转换完成也不代表运行已验证。结果可能依赖 Hide2Less compat，可一起分发，或添加并刷新 Banana 源下载依赖。
description: 独立的手机端转换工具。选择 DEB 后生成新的安装包，保留原始文件。
通过系统分享将结果交给用户选择的包管理器，或保存到文件；不会自动安装插件。
features: App 提供 Rootless、RootHide 两种安装包，转换结果统一为 Rootless
兼容转换与直接转换两种模式
支持更多常见插件安装包的读取与转换
按需导出已内置的 compat 兼容包，可随插件分发或从 Banana 源获取
文件导入、转换进度与日志、系统分享
简体中文、繁体中文、英文及社区入口
compatibility: 最低 iOS 15；按当前越狱环境安装对应的 Rootless 或 RootHide App 包
工具需要 dpkg >= 1.21.18、ldid；compat 仅由转换后的 Rootless 插件按需使用
不会扩展原插件的系统或硬件支持范围；仅有 arm64e 的插件仍要求相应设备支持
RootHide 已在 iPhone 15 Pro / iOS 17.3.1 验证文件导入、转换与分享；Rootless 本版尚待实机确认。转换后的插件仍需在目标环境验证运行。
usage: 安装与你的越狱环境对应的 App 包，在主屏幕打开 Hide2Less，选择 .deb 文件。
选择兼容转换或直接转换；完成后从系统分享窗口保存结果，或交给包管理器。
若提示依赖 compat，使用“分享兼容包”将其与插件一起分发；接收者先安装 compat，再安装插件。也可添加并刷新 https://iyaway.github.io/ 自动下载依赖。
两种环境均通过系统分享导出或保存结果。遇到不支持的安装包时，按提示交由开发者适配。

changes: 修复 RootHide 环境下从 iCloud 导入安装包失败的问题。
提升部分插件安装包的读取与转换兼容性。
修复选包后的转换按钮状态，并改进失败提示。
支持在手机上将受支持的 RootHide 插件包转换为 Rootless 安装包。
提供兼容转换、直接转换与系统分享，保留原始文件。
提供简体中文、繁体中文、英文，以及兼容包获取与分发说明。

en.name: Hide2Less
en.tagline: Convert supported RootHide tweak packages to Rootless packages on device.
en.notice: This is a beta release. Conversion may still fail on some iOS 16 Rootless devices; investigation is ongoing. Not every package can be converted, and conversion does not prove runtime compatibility. Results may require Hide2Less compat. Distribute it with the tweak, or add and refresh the Banana repository to download it.
description: An independent on-device converter. Choose a DEB to create a new package while preserving the original file.
Use system sharing to send the result to a package manager of your choice or save it to Files. Tweaks are never installed automatically.
features: Rootless and RootHide app packages; converted packages always target Rootless
Improved reading and conversion support for additional tweak packages
Export the bundled compat package when needed, distribute it with tweaks, or obtain it from the Banana repository
File import, progress and logs, and system sharing
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, and community links
compatibility: Requires iOS 15 or later; install the app package for your Rootless or RootHide environment
Requires dpkg >= 1.21.18 and ldid; compat is used only when required by a converted Rootless tweak
Does not expand the original tweak's system or hardware support; arm64e-only tweaks still require compatible hardware

Import, conversion and sharing were verified on iPhone 15 Pro / iOS 17.3.1 with RootHide. This Rootless build still requires physical-device confirmation. Converted tweaks must be tested in their target environment.
usage: Install the app package for your jailbreak environment, open Hide2Less from the Home Screen, and select a .deb file.
Choose compatibility or direct mode. When conversion finishes, save the result or send it to a package manager using system sharing.

If compat is required, use Share compatibility package to distribute it with the tweak. Recipients install compat first, then the tweak. Alternatively, add and refresh https://iyaway.github.io/ for automatic dependency downloads.
Both environments export or save results through system sharing. Unsupported packages require developer adaptation.

changes: Fix failed iCloud package imports on RootHide.
Improve reading and conversion compatibility for additional tweak packages.
Fix the conversion button state after selecting a package and improve failure messages.
Convert supported RootHide tweak packages to Rootless packages on device.
Includes compatibility and direct modes, system sharing, and preservation of the original file.
Includes Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, and guidance for obtaining and distributing the compatibility package.
